notes.title: REFORMULATION OF GAME MECHANICS
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41326951/18dabcfa147167097d5cecdc85338cae631f7cad.png[/img]After reading the opinions of Marmoset game players, I decided to remake several game mechanics to bring better gameplay for everyone:


[*]Most traps, such as spikes, deal damage instead of draining the player's health.

 [*]Poisoned lakes poison the player, instead of zeroing out lives.

 [*]It is now possible to swim in poisoned lakes.

 [*]Chimbra Artificial Intelligence now has 3 abilities, which are mine, heal health and recover energy.

 [*]Some physical and visual stages changed.

 [*]UI screens now adapt to the size of the user's computer or notebook.

 [*]Lots of errors.

 [*]Among other small details.




FUTURE UPDATES:


 [*]Addition of Spanish and French languages.

 [*]New quests.

 [*]New skin for Luna.

 [*]New biomes with Boss.

 [*]Continuation of Luna's mysterious dream story.

 [*]And much more.

notes.title: AN UNUSUAL VISIT
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41326951/db561104481b6c203ca170389c4b335b6a446ec0.png[/img]

Satoru is a slime that has developed reasoning and intelligence above other monsters, even more intelligent than the Generals themselves.

  Although Satoru is a slime, a hostile species inside the caves, he never attacked anyone and because of that the Seventh General Dencra gave the order to eliminate him, but Satoru managed to escape to the cave entrance, where João lives. of Ore.

  João was scared at first, but he soon realized that Satoru was not a threat, so instead they both became great friends, including Satoru who collects the minerals for João to sell in his little store.

  Satoru lives in the Cave of the Lake house and on day 2 he decides to visit Luna in secret, he says he has a secret to tell her, but in exchange, Luna has to take 9 puzzle pieces that are scattered throughout the levels of the cave, Satoru also promises 2500 Purple Crystals for every puzzle piece given to him.

Update scheduled for October 29th.
